multi_entity_note: Two parties: Cool Technologies Inc. (COOL TECH) and Veteran Technology Group, LLC (VET TECH).
processing_note: Any notice required or permitted to be given under this Agreement shall be in writing, by hand delivery, commercial overnight courier or registered or certified U.S. Mail, to the address stated below for COOL TECH or to the address stated below for VET TECH, and shall be deemed duly given upon receipt, or if by registered or certified mail three (3) business days following deposit in the U.S. Mail.

contract.document_name.rationale: The heading and preamble name it the Strategic Alliance Agreement.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The preamble says the agreement is entered into as of the 26th day of May, 2017; the header date May 04, 2017 is not given as the agreement date.

contract.effective_date.rationale: The preamble expressly designates the 26th day of May, 2017 as the effective date.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: Expiry is the later of five years from the date hereof or project completion, not stated as a date.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Article X.F: governed by the laws of the State of Missouri.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: The agreement renews automatically for successive one year periods.

contract.notice_period.rationale: Notice of non-renewal must be given at least thirty (30) days prior to expiration.
